name: Japanese lemmatizer rules
attribution: Japanese lemmatizer rule table written for qinqin by the project; qinqin contributors, CC BY 4.0 (https://github.com/Elaktrato/qinqin).
notice:
The rules that turn inflected Japanese (食べました, してしまった, 読んでる) into dictionary forms, written for qinqin and released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Credit: qinqin contributors, CC BY 4.0, [the qinqin repository](https://github.com/Elaktrato/qinqin).

The same table is built into the server; this pack lets clients download it as a data package.
